assertions.name: symmetric-block lone/bond ratio = q² exactly
assertions.source: trivial rep σ_i↦q ⇒ e⁻=σ₀σ₁σ₀↦q³, σ↦q, ratio q³/q=q²; numerically matched to 1e-9 via the Hoefsmit seminormal block

assertions.name: only the symmetric block (the C₂ᵥ-selected one) gives q²
assertions.source: alt→q⁻², std→0; the symmetric block is singled out

description: H₂O lone/bond weight ratio = q² DERIVED from the symmetric Wedderburn block. The C₂ᵥ assembly projector (S₂ H-exchange stabiliser, rem:h2o-c2v-from-projector) selects the symmetric (trivial) rep of the local H₃(q), on which σ↦q so bond σ↦q and lone e⁻=σ₀σ₁σ₀↦q³, giving lone/bond = q² EXACTLY (verified across all 3 blocks: sym→q², alt→q⁻², std→0). Feeding r=q² into the trace-weighted VSEPR (n=1) gives θ=104.72° (obs 104.5°). PROMOTES the earlier kernel-conditional q² near-match to a kernel-independent derived ratio; only the 0.22° residual carries the VSEPR-kernel/geometry approximation. No fit.

data.finding: DERIVED: w_lone/w_bond = q² = 1.232052 on the symmetric Wedderburn block that the C₂ᵥ assembly projector selects (σ↦q ⇒ e⁻↦q³). This is a ratio of Hecke eigenvalues — kernel-independent, not fitted. The VSEPR angle at r=q² is 104.72° vs observed 104.5° (+0.22°); the residual is the VSEPR-kernel + points-on-a-sphere approximation, not the ratio. Promotes the owner's q² lever from a Coulomb-conditional near-match to a derivation.
